description: Rung 4 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Live React RepoClinicPanel at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/RepoClinicPanel.tsx. Renders 12 required sections: repo_analysis_status, toolchain_status, verifier_status, diagnosis_status, quarantined_patch_status, temp_verifier_status, approval_requirement, source_mutation_status, post_apply_verifier_status, rollback_status, evidence_status, training_eligibility_status. 'REPAIR_VERIFIED' fixed badge requires both sourceMutationApplied AND postApplyVerifierPassed; otherwise reads FIXED_LABEL_DISABLED_NO_POST_APPLY_EVIDENCE. Captions enforced: 'Diagnosis does NOT authorize source mutation', 'Local model admission does NOT authorize source mutation', source_mutation status is rendered with explicit 'distinct from approval status' wording, VERIFIER_MISSING / TOOLCHAIN_MISSING badges visible, training status reads false everywhere. Tests forbid mutating Tauri verbs and unqualified success text.
